name: OKX (proof-of-reserves address files, manual download only)
operator: OKX (Aux Cayes FinTech Co. Ltd. and affiliates)
tier_rationale: Established exchange operator with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 BR2). V3LUM never contacts this host: the analyst downloads the proof-of-reserves file in a browser and imports it with provenance (P358 cond 2).

reliability.justification: Exchange-published reserve addresses, each with a signed 'I am an OKX address' message (ownership claimed by the exchange itself); snapshots are dated.

proof_of_reserves.title: OKX proof-of-reserves address file (CSV: coin, network, snapshot height, address, signed message, signatures) - manual download by the analyst

terms.reviewer: batch p2-G09-3 (research C0788: 'Exchange website terms (manual download for internal labelling)'; not reviewed by legal)

proof_of_reserves.notes: Never fetched by V3LUM (JS app; the files sit behind /en-br/proof-of-reserves/download). P358 cond 2: the analyst imports the downloaded file with exchange, PoR date and source URL (crypto_address_labels.import_por_file or the drop folder with a provenance sidecar); signed rows are CONFIRMED ('high'), every PoR label loses one confidence step after 12 months. Live 2026-11-26: the page answers 200 server-side rendered with no address data (Cloudflare __cf_bm, ratelimit-limit 202). File format documented at https://github.com/okx/proof-of-reserves. Not declared by any module as a registry source: imported files are analyst-provided local data; legal to confirm internal-labelling use of the exchange terms.
